candidate_rule: Carry a Stage 1 record only if an immediately lower FanDuel Floor exists and its locked-L10 HR is at least 7/10. This uses the model's explicit 70% minimum permitted final-leg HR; it is a viability screen, not a prediction or approval. Do not impose an unsupported 8/10 cutoff.
exclusion_rationale: No records excluded: all 15 have an available immediately-lower Floor with at least 7/10 on the locked L10. The candidate set therefore remains 15 after applying the documented downstream viability standard; no artificial exclusions are introduced.
